biological_question: Is the three-source positive Tmax association with observed night relative GPS step speed retained if every previously q-qualified tag/solar-date DAY and NIGHT observation uses exactly three GPS intervals selected independently of step speed?
q_formula: log1p(median NIGHT accepted GPS original source step km/h) - log1p(median DAY accepted GPS original source step km/h)
balanced_step_algorithm: Sort ORIGINAL valid 0.5-2h same-source timestamp/part intervals in original hour order, in each original tag/solar-day DAY and NIGHT independently keep deterministic chronological first, central (index floor((n-1)/2)) and last accepted original speed; n>=3 by previous native q quality. Select on original GPS interval rank alone, never on speed values/q, temperature, daylength or weather. All originally qualifying q tag/year/solar date remains eligible; original DAY/NIGHT medians and original source q must replay exactly before applying the diagnostic.
same_tag_date_model: Use exactly the PRIOR source weather/tag/year/month/day cohort admitted for original 3-predictor joint q~Tmax+daylength+prior30d P-ET0 within calendar tag-year-month. No extra YEAR/DAY/SOURCE screening, and require original model q coefficients+full tag bootstrap confidence interval replay exactly. Both balanced DAY and NIGHT and balanced Q=NIGHT-DAY coefficients fitted on exactly SAME prior year/month/date/partial design; q_bal_coef == night_bal_coef - day_bal_coef for every tag-year, source mean, all matched bootstrap draws.
original_source_persistence: 3 original source IDs only. All original source UUID/size/MD5 and original full-source q/daylength original tag means replay; all provider original daily ERA5 physical SHA and historic source q/weather coefficients identical. Any source data drift is SOURCE_HOLD, never accepted as a changed sampling robustness effect.
bootstrap_original_tag_unit: Resample ORIGINAL independent tagged animals with exact same 2000 draw index stream in day/night/q on the same cohort, no GPS event p values.
source_rights_and_privacy: Keep raw original GPS animal IDs, exact tracking location/date, individual slopes, raw interval counts and sampled GPS records inside ephemeral CI. Public outputs only DOI source aggregated means/tag counts, nominal 95 tag-bootstrap interval, fraction of source original qualifying dates with unequal DAY vs NIGHT GPS valid segment counts, and explicit HOLD.
